fact: From 27 November to 6 December 2022 Qena governorate trained external collectors of local units to collect and print receipts on tablets through a unified central system, with 27 tablets and 27 mini printers supplied in a first phase.
title: لطباعة الإيصالات.. تدريب محصلي الوحدات المحلية بقنا على استخدام التابلت
